existing_mapping.evidence: The ParkingLot class includes attributes for uniqueNumber, name, street, and city, indicating it contains information about the parking lot identity and location.
The ParkingLot class includes an attribute `availableSpaces` which displays the number of available spaces in the parking lot.
There is a direct relationship between Vehicle and Client classes, ensuring each vehicle is associated with a single client.
The ParkingSession class contains attributes like startTime and vehicleNumber to capture parking session details.
The ParkingSpace class has an attribute size, defining the space suitability for vehicle accommodation.
Conveyor class contains an attribute maxWeightCapacity, defining the weight limit for vehicle transport.
ParkingSession class has a relationship to Conveyor showing vehicles may be transported by a conveyor, but there is no permanent storage of conveyor data after the session.
The ParkingLot class is associated with PriceList that includes pricing details for different durations.
The Client class can have a ClubMembership defining relations indicating membership management.
The ClubMembership class has a discount attribute, indicating fixed discounts for members on parking sessions.
The ClubMembership class has a method isEligibleForFreeParking, representing a free parking session for new club members in the registration month.
The Administrator class has operations for generating annual summary reports concerning the incomes of ParkWise.
The generateAnnualSummaryReport function relates to guidelines indicating the inclusion of payment and vehicle count data.
There are notes on generating reports with ordered data, ensuring criteria like city and total amounts are considered.
Notes associated with the Administrator class suggest generating reports in PDF and XML formats.
Administrator class includes methods for generating reports; this pertains to club growth and member insights.
Details regarding monthly report insights for club growth and member analytics are covered in class definitions.
The guidelines state ordering for monthly growth report aligns with ascending month order, as described.
